title: Grilled German Sausage Skewers
description: A classic German-inspired dish featuring grilled sausage skewers with a zesty smoky twist. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner or outdoor gathering.

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.notes: soak in water for 30 minutes before grilling

ingredients.name: zesty mustard
ingredients.notes: such as Dijon or whole-grain mustard

instructions: 2. In a small bowl, whisk together zesty mustard and smoky paprika.
4. Thread sausage, onion, and bell pepper onto skewers.
5. Brush skewers with mustard mixture, then season with salt and pepper.
6. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until sausage is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
7. Serve immediately, garnished with additional smoky paprika if desired.
